title: さくらさくら (Sakura Sakura — Cherry Blossoms)
description: One of Japan's most iconic songs, originally composed as a koto finger exercise in the Edo period and first published with lyrics in 1888. Cherry blossoms fill the spring sky as far as the eye can see — are they mist or clouds? The song calls the listener to come and see for themselves.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese folk song, Edo period; lyrics published 1888)
